run_query_vlm: run the query function to send a multimodal message with text and image to a vision-language model
create_query_function: create a query function that POSTs a payload to the Hugging Face chat completions API
test_query_vlm: test the query function with a text-and-image payload targeting Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct
summarize_query_response: summarize the query function response by extracting choices[0].message from the JSON output
build_vlm_request: build a conversational VLM request payload with multimodal messages containing text and image_url content
